// NEGATIVE PROBE for tests/unit/score-containment.test.ts.
//
// Internal, non-rendered uses of the score value that the guard must NOT flag:
// the engine may compute, store, hash and compare the figure — what it may not
// do is put it in front of a customer. This is the shape of the version
// writer's contextHash and of translation-namespace property access
// (`t.wallet.healthScore.title` is a KEY PATH, not the value).
import { createHash } from "node:crypto"

export function fingerprint(score: { overallScore: number; indeterminate: boolean }): string {
    return createHash("sha256")
        .update(`${score.overallScore}::${score.indeterminate ? 1 : 0}`)
        .digest("hex")
}

export function walletCopy(t: { wallet: { healthScore: { title: string } } }) {
    return <h3>{t.wallet.healthScore.title}</h3>
}
